``` {python}
import numpy as np
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins
```

``` {python}
penguins = load_penguins()
penguins.head()
```

``` {python}
penguins.groupby("species").mean(numeric_only=True)[['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].round()
```

``` {python}
penguins['body_mass_lb'] = (penguins['body_mass_g'] / 453.592).round()
penguins.dropna()
```
